parameters.content:
## Inbox · Receive (Lesson 5.7)
Every adapter calls this with { channel, thread_id, from_value, from_type, text, received_at, raw_id }.
1. Normalise (phones +234..., emails lowercase).
2. Resolve the identity: an existing identity with that exact value -> that customer; none -> a new customer with an UNVERIFIED identity.
3. A phone or email typed in the text that matches ANOTHER customer's verified identity -> a link suggestion, never a merge; needs_verification = true.
4. Upsert the conversation (same open order -> same conversation, whichever channel) and save the message once (raw_id).
5. Label, then priority, owner and response target in code.
6. The agent answers with the whole picture (get_customer_context) on reply_channel only; no order or payment details if needs_verification. Refunds and credits need Tolu's approval and are written to decisions.
7. Inbox · Send replies through the right door; other open threads get one short note.

Credentials: Postgres (Supabase); OpenAI (both model nodes); Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_MODEL, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, YOUR_SEND_WORKFLOW_ID, YOUR_CONTEXT_WORKFLOW_ID.

## Supabase tables
-- Run once in Supabase
create table customers (id bigserial primary key, display_name text,
  segment text, consent_marketing boolean default false,
  created_at timestamptz default now());
create table identities (id bigserial primary key,
  customer_id bigint references customers(id),
  type text, value text, verified boolean default false,
  source text, added_at timestamptz default now());
create index on identities (type, value);
create table conversations (id bigserial primary key,
  customer_id bigint references customers(id), channel text,
  thread_id text, status text default 'open', priority int,
  assigned_to text, sla_due_at timestamptz,
  last_customer_msg_at timestamptz, order_ref text,
  reply_channel text, needs_verification boolean default false,
  pinged_80 boolean default false, escalated boolean default false);
create table messages (id bigserial primary key,
  conversation_id bigint references conversations(id),
  direction text, channel text, thread_id text, text text,
  at timestamptz default now(), sent_by text, raw_id text unique);
create table decisions (id bigserial primary key,
  customer_id bigint references customers(id), type text,
  value text, decided_by text, at timestamptz default now());
create table link_suggestions (id bigserial primary key,
  customer_id bigint, suggested_customer_id bigint,
  evidence text, status text default 'open',
  created_at timestamptz default now());

Create a Postgres credential with your Supabase database connection details and select it in every Postgres node.

parameters.query: select customer_id, verified from identities where type = $1 and value = $2 order by verified desc, added_at asc limit 1;

with c as (insert into customers (display_name) values ($1) returning id),
     i as (insert into identities (customer_id, type, value, verified, source)
           select id, $2, $3, false, $4 from c)
select id as customer_id, false as verified from c;
select customer_id as other_customer_id from identities where verified and value = $1 and customer_id <> $2 limit 1;

with existing as (
  select id from conversations
  where customer_id = $1 and status = 'open'
    and ($2 = '' or order_ref = $2 or order_ref is null)
  order by last_customer_msg_at desc limit 1
), ins as (
  insert into conversations (customer_id, channel, thread_id, status, order_ref, last_customer_msg_at, reply_channel, needs_verification)
  select $1, $3, $4, 'open', nullif($2, ''), $5, $3, $6
  where not exists (select 1 from existing)
  returning id, needs_verification
), upd as (
  update conversations
  set last_customer_msg_at = $5, reply_channel = $3, channel = $3, thread_id = $4,
      order_ref = coalesce(order_ref, nullif($2, '')), needs_verification = needs_verification or $6
  where id in (select id from existing)
  returning id, needs_verification
)
select id as conversation_id, needs_verification from ins
union all
select id, needs_verification from upd;

insert into messages (conversation_id, direction, channel, thread_id, text, at, sent_by, raw_id)
values ($1, 'in', $2, $3, $4, $5, 'customer', $6)
on conflict (raw_id) do nothing
returning conversation_id;

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You label customer comments about Harvest Lane, a fresh-produce delivery business in Ibadan. Comments may be in Nigerian English, Pidgin, Yoruba, slang or emoji. Return sentiment, topic, urgent (needs a person today), intent and confidence (0 to 1, your honest estimate).

Examples:
1. "Una tomatoes fresh well well, I go order again" -> positive, quality, praise, urgent false
2. "Price don cost o" -> neutral, price, complaint, urgent false (about price, not anger)
3. "This bread is sick 🔥" -> positive, quality, praise, urgent false (sick = amazing)
4. "deadly jollof, we go come back" -> positive, quality, praise, urgent false (deadly = excellent)
5. "Great, another 'fresh' delivery of soft tomatoes 🙄" -> negative, quality, complaint, urgent false (sarcasm)
6. "Half the onions were rotten and nobody is picking my calls" -> negative, quality, complaint, urgent true
7. "My son was sick after eating your ugu" -> negative, food safety, complaint, urgent true
8. "What time do you open on Sundays?" -> neutral, hours, question, urgent false
9. "Do you supply restaurants weekly? We need about 20 crates" -> positive, other, lead, urgent false
10. "Delivery late again. Third time this month." -> negative, late delivery, complaint, urgent false
11. "Veggies dey fresh but the rider was rude" -> mixed, other, complaint, urgent false
12. "I paid since Monday, nothing came. I want my money back" -> negative, refund, complaint, urgent true
13. "Earn N50k daily!!! Click the link in my bio" -> neutral, other, spam, urgent false

parameters.query: update conversations set priority = $1, assigned_to = $2, sla_due_at = $3, pinged_80 = false, escalated = false where id = $4;

options.systemMessage:
You are Sage Desk, Harvest Lane's assistant. Always call get_customer_context first and read the whole timeline and the decisions table before writing, so you never contradict an earlier answer on any channel.
Reply only on reply_channel, in its style: email = full sentences, greeting, signature 'Harvest Lane'; whatsapp = short, friendly, one message; instagram/facebook = short and warm.
If needs_verification is true, don't share order or payment details; ask them to confirm with the code we send to the number or email on their order.
Refunds, credits and exceptions: never promise them. If one may be due, fill decision_request (type refund|credit|exception, value, reason) and say Tolu is reviewing it. Only decisions already in the decisions table are facts.
If the owner is Tolu or Bisi, acknowledge and say who will follow up and when.
Return JSON: { reply_text, decision_request }. decision_request is null when none is needed.

parameters.name: get_customer_context
parameters.description: Returns this customer's timeline across all channels, open orders and decisions (refunds, credits, exceptions). Call it before every reply.

parameters.query: insert into decisions (customer_id, type, value, decided_by) values ($1, $2, $3, 'Tolu') returning type, value;

select distinct on (m.channel, m.thread_id) m.channel, m.thread_id, m.raw_id as reply_to_message_id, m.at as last_customer_msg_at
from messages m
where m.conversation_id = $1 and m.direction = 'in' and m.channel <> $2
  and m.at > now() - interval '2 days'
  and not exists (select 1 from messages o where o.conversation_id = m.conversation_id and o.channel = m.channel
                  and o.thread_id = m.thread_id and o.direction = 'out' and o.at > m.at)
order by m.channel, m.thread_id, m.at desc;

parameters.content:
## Sage: a wrong merge is worse than a missed one
Merge only on a verified identifier. A number typed in a DM only creates a link suggestion for a person to check; same name never links anything.

A new handle on a new channel gets its own customer until a verified identifier links them.
